modules.description: Single flat PRESENT-80 lightweight block cipher with serial load/unload, iterative one-round-per-clock encryption, FSM control, inlined S-box, pLayer, and key schedule.
modules.name: present80

ports.description: Serial load enable; shifts din in while high
ports.name: load_en

ports.description: Serial data input, key MSB-first then plaintext MSB-first
ports.name: din

ports.description: Serial unload enable; shifts ciphertext out while high and done is asserted
ports.name: shift_out_en

ports.description: Asserted when ciphertext is fully computed; held until reset or new load
ports.name: done

rationale: The spec explicitly mandates a single flat Verilog module with no sub-modules. All functional blocks (FSM, load/unload shift registers, bit/round counters, addRoundKey XOR, 16-nibble S-box lookup, 64-bit pLayer permutation, and key schedule rotation/S-box/counter-XOR) are inlined as combinational logic and always blocks inside the one present80 module.
